stoic.text: What unsettles you is often the view you take of things, not the things themselves.
Your attention and your response are yours to choose.
Do the task in front of you, and do it well.
Hold firmly what is in your control. Hold lightly what is not.
A short pause leaves room for a better choice.
Whatever happens, you can meet it with wisdom, courage, justice and temperance.
This day is enough to practise in. Begin where you are.

meeting.text: Say what you mean, briefly and kindly.
Question the idea, respect the person.
Your part is your preparation and your conduct. The outcome is shared.
If the room grows heated, slow your voice and your breath.
Before you disagree, ask one more question.
